statement: For every allowed height b, the homogeneous functional b(v) vol(v)1/n on centred common lc rays has a unique minimizing ray. Its A = 1 representative depends continuously on the coefficients of b while the height stays strictly positive on the fixed slice. It is fixed by every automorphism preserving the slice and the height. If the coefficients of b are rational, its minimizer w is the normalized-volume minimizer of an effective rational klt pair on x ∈ S. More precisely, one can choose an effective rational lc Cartier boundary Ψ with exactly the common lc rays as its zero-discrepancy locus, and one positive rational number λ, fixed independently of the competing valuation, such that Ψλ = Ψ − λb0H + λ ∑︂ ℓ bℓ div(Gℓ) (E.18) is effective and klt, and w minimizes ˆ︂ volS,Ψλ among all centred valuations. On the common lc rays its discrepancy is λb. 69 For the same rational height, the algebra grw R is finitely generated and normal. Its spectrum S0 is a klt Q-Gorenstein cone. Write h0, F0 j , G0 ℓ for initial forms, w0 for the grading valuation, and Q0, b0 for the analogous central slice and height. Then (S0, div(h0)) is lc, AS0 (w0) = w0(h0) = 1, w0 ∈ Q0, and b0 is strictly positive on Q0. The valuation w0 minimizes b0 vol1/n on its centred part.
